text:
kyle (support): FYI customer reported an SSE stream that ends with an unterminated JSON object. client-side JSON.parse throws. they see no finish_reason and no final event.

maya (devex): can you paste a minimal repro and any request ids?

kyle (support): repro we used (curl):
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-large' \
  -d '{"prompt":"say hi and then a long tail"}'
```
sample SSE output (truncated):
```
data: {"id":"req_7f9a12","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hi"}}]}

data: {"id":"req_7f9a12","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" and a bit more"}}]}

data: {"id":"req_7f9a12","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" unfinished tail..."}}]   <-- connection drops here, no closing braces sent
```
client sees a trailing fragment like `..."unfinished tail..."}}]` with missing `}` and no `data: [DONE]`. JSON.parse fails.

eric (runtime): I pulled the backend logs for req_7f9a12. We have an upstream LB (envoy) that rotated TLS connection while the final buffer was flushed. Relevant log lines: `socket closed by peer during write`, `stream flush incomplete`, `RST_STREAM sent`. Looks like an auth rotation handshake triggered the LB to reset the connection before the final chunk was committed.

maya (devex): interesting — customer mentioned they rotate session tokens every 30s as part of their client infra. could client-side token refresh be colliding with long-lived SSE?

kyle (support): customer confirmed they rotate tokens and re-open connections. But their client sometimes tries to resume and then JSON becomes unparsable (leftover fragment).

eric (runtime): probable chain: token rotation -> LB issues drain/reset -> runtime tries to finish and send final event but RST_STREAM interrupts the last chunk -> client reconnects and concatenates fragments, resulting in unterminated JSON.

maya (devex): short-term mitigations for customers:
- recommend a small client change to treat incomplete final event as transient and retry the last message set when no `data: [DONE]` or `finish_reason` present.
- add robust SSE parser that tolerates incomplete final JSON and re-requests the missing piece.

kyle (support): asked customer to provide HAR or curl log; they sent the raw bytes — confirmed we see a final chunk cut mid-object.

eric (runtime): engineering action items:
1) Ensure platform always emits an explicit sentinel final event on a separate chunk, e.g. `data: [DONE]` then newline, then close. That reduces chance of mid-object truncation.
2) Add a heartbeat/send-ping every 10s to avoid LB idle drain during long tails.
3) Investigate LB config: avoid aggressive RST on token rotation; ensure graceful drain.

deploy-bot: staged build with explicit final sentinel + 10s heartbeat pushed to staging (INF-1234).

kyle (support): customer impact: parsing errors (some app crashes), losing 1-2% of requests during busy windows. customer asks for P1 fix.

eric (runtime): I'll push the staged change to prod gate after one quick smoke in staging. ETA ~15m. Will attach correlation ids for all affected reqs.

maya (devex): also logging note — please capture `request_id`, `client-ip`, and `last-sent-bytes` on any incomplete stream so we can correlate with LB traces.

kyle (support): thanks — passing to customer: workaround guidance + we'll inform once deploy completes. tagging @eric for follow-up. :thumbsup:

eric (runtime): noted; I'll post update here when prod deploy is live.
